svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 07 · Riverside · 07/12 Victoria Avenue (Common)
svg.desc: A long old parkway lined with palms, running out past the groves. Best on a bike, early. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
